outcome: Maternal outcomes (invasive ventilation, admission to critical care, pre-term birth, death)
cohort: Pregnant women in Austria who tested positive for SARS-CoV-2
finding: Pregnant women with COVID-19 were at higher risk for invasive ventilation, critical care admission, and pre-term birth, but the risk of vertical transmission appeared to be insignificant.
mod_finding: Pregnant women with COVID-19 had a higher rate of preterm birth compared to the total population of pregnant women.
